_note: v2.4 plan 09 acceptance row I7 (same-chat reload), written 2026-09-25 for the acceptance matrix because no existing fixture covered the silent-rewrite and unfingerprinted halves (v24-02-same-chat-reload.json covers the in-page reloadCurrentChat path and is run beside this one). No model call: every read is a debugResponse, because the row tests hydrate reconcile, not extraction. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v24-acc-I7.json --sandbox --group 1759606632088. Three player lines are consumed (key, lamp, map), each with a latching delta and a fact. Arm A, plain reload: the page reloads (reload verb) and reopens the same chat; no rollback, state equal to the recording. Arm B, silent rewrite: message 2 is rewritten in the chat file with ctx.saveChat (no MESSAGE_EDITED/UPDATED), then the page reloads; plan 02 T3's reconcile at hydrate must roll back from 2 (expect.rollbackOutcome applied fromMessage 2) and the story must equal the recording taken after line 1. Arm C, unfingerprinted boundary: the blob's fingerprints are removed (the shape of a capture that had nothing to fingerprint) and message 1 is rewritten silently, then the page reloads; an unknown fingerprint is never a mismatch, so no rollback runs, the state equals the recording, and the hydrate re-baselines the fingerprints from the chat as it is. record_state recordings do not survive a page reload, so the fixture stashes them in sessionStorage and restores them with rollbackSeq 0 (the rollback counter restarts with the page).

requires.why: the row tests hydrate reconcile, not extraction: the page reloads wipe the debug pins, and on a live lane the post-reload rollback re-reads with the real model, growing memory between the recordings (T7 SUITE); green x2 on the no-model lane

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const greetings = ctx.chat.length; for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error(`the sandbox chat still holds ${ctx.chat.length} message(s) after clearing its greetings, so every message id below would name the wrong line`); sessionStorage.removeItem('so-acc-i7'); sessionStorage.removeItem('so-acc-i7-rec'); return { greetingsCleared: greetings };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); const state = rt.getEngineState(); if (!state || state.activeCheckpointId !== 'start') throw new Error(`the story did not load at start: ${JSON.stringify(state && state.activeCheckpointId)}`); return { cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0, boundary: state.boundary };
